confidence_notes: Food and drink estimates use 2026 Positano signals and nearby Italian benchmarks. Cocktail and wine estimates reflect local prices relative to beer. Accommodation figures are holistic July high-season estimates without live listing checks and are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are benchmarked against Naples and Italy price indexes, adjusted for Positano's Amalfi Coast tourist premium. Accommodation reflects Positano's peak-season demand and limited room supply.
